newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday amid sluggish demand, traders said.
They said a deal was done in the afternoon at 47.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Surabaya for August shipment. Prices at other centres were unchanged.

"Traders sold rubber at that level in Surabaya most probably because they haven't heard the news about the deal in Palembang. They may realise it tomorrow and will sell rubber at a much higher price," said one trader.
SIR20 was quoted at 48.00 fob Surabaya in the morning.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 48.25 cents/lb fob Medan, 48.00 fob Palembang following an overnight deal there, at 48.00 fob Padang, at 47.75 fob Jambi and at 47.50 fob Pontianak.
